title: Settling the Vale's Hollow King is presented as three parallel options (verses, crown, or steel) with no hint that choosing steel routes you onto a separate 'Hollows burned' progress counter instead of the 'Hollows rested' counter the main six-holds quest text foregrounds -- only learned this distinction later from NPC dialogue at Highward, and it mattered: the Hollow Throne's peaceful 'Fill it' ending explicitly requires rested (not burned) holds.
